steps.code:
# Get transactions sent this month (May 2023)
access_token = login_result['access_token']
transactions = []
page = 0
while True:
    result = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=access_token,
        direction='sent',
        min_created_at='2023-05-01',
        max_created_at='2023-05-31',
        page_index=page,
        page_limit=20
    )
    if isinstance(result, list):
        transactions.extend(result)
        if len(result) < 20:
            break
        page += 1
    else:
        print("Error:", result)
        break
print("Number of sent transactions this month:", len(transactions))
for t in transactions:
    print(t)
